patch.oldString: Keep the last row for each sku because exports arrive in chronological order. After selecting the last row, omit entries whose deleted value is true.
patch.newString: For each sku, select the row with the greatest numeric revision; if revisions tie, select the last occurrence in the file. File order is not chronological. Only after selecting winners, omit entries whose deleted value is true so that lower-revision rows cannot resurrect newer tombstones.
